verdict.rationale: The franchise-tax and annual-report portal, Delaware's only mandatory-online filing, documents a keyless file-number entry: "Please enter your Business Entity File Number below to start filing your Annual Report or Pay Taxes". It needs no account, offers a name search for founders who don't know their entity number, and uses an optional saved-session ID rather than a login. An image CAPTCHA gates that entry page, but it is an anti-bot step, not an account requirement. Missing for 10: hands-on confirmation that the flow completes without an account (the page was recorded, never used), and documentation of whether the online name-reservation or Document Filing Service paths also work without an account.
